mapper.select: SELECT * FROM approval_instance_action_log WHERE instance_id = #{instanceId} ORDER BY id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO approval_instance ( instance_id, corpid, flow_definition_id, flow_code, flow_version, business_code, approval_scene, subject_id, request_id, submitter_id, subject_summary, subject_snapshot_json, flow_snapshot_json, status, current_node_no, submitted_at, completed_at, del, add_time, update_time ) VALUES ( #{instanceId}, #{corpid}, #{flowDefinitionId}, #{flowCode}, #{flowVersion}, #{businessCode}, #{approvalScene}, #{subjectId}, #{requestId}, #{submitterId}, #{subjectSummary}, #{subjectSnapshotJson}, #{flowSnapshotJson}, #{status}, #{currentNodeNo}, #{submittedAt}, #{completedAt}, #{del}, #{addTime}, #{updateTime} )
mapper.update: UPDATE approval_instance SET status = #{status}, current_node_no = #{currentNodeNo}, completed_at = #{completedAt}, update_time = #{updateTime} WHERE instance_id = #{instanceId} AND del = 0
UPDATE approval_instance_task SET status = #{status}, comment = #{comment}, handled_at = #{handledAt}, update_time = #{updateTime} WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'PENDING' AND del = 0
